connector.name: FibX
connector.registryDescription: Swap, transfer, track a portfolio and use Aave V3 on Base, Citrea, HyperEVM and Monad.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package fibx. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace finance.fibrous, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FIBX_API_URL
env.description: Custom fibx-server URL for Privy wallet operations. Optional; only needed when self-hosting the backend.

env.name: FIBX_SESSION_SECRET
env.description: Encryption key for the local session file. Optional; auto-generated per machine when unset.
